name: Peter's Test Arcade
notes: Unlisted review copies for play. This is not a release of the live arcade.
Anyone with the URL can open it. The noindex tag asks crawlers to skip the page. It is not a privacy lock.
Not linked from the live hub. Live player pages, vault, and service worker were not changed.
To add or remove a game, edit the games array in this file and add or delete that folder under games/. The shelf reads this file. There is no admin form and nothing here is publicly writable.
Primary Play buttons open games/<id>/ which is the runnable folder (HTML, JS, images, and any audio the build already had).

Sound was left as each build already implemented it: Web Audio synthesis for music and effects. No external audio files were added. Prepare the Manger also keeps its silent generated clip that starts mobile audio.

Copied service workers use a pa-test- cache prefix, delete only caches with that prefix, and ignore requests outside their own folder. Save keys are prefixed with pa-test- so they do not read or write live saves.

The live Peter's Arcade service worker is registered at /peters-arcade/sw.js, so its scope already includes this folder. It was not modified. It is network-first and only deletes caches named peters-arcade-*. A copied game worker does not take over the live games.

noindex and a back link to this shelf.

games.title: Hope and Constable Duncan

games.warn: Prototype, not finished. Mobile play in this build was already incomplete.
games.limitations: Missing files or buttons that never appear would be an integration fault, separate from the unfinished mobile mechanics. This shelf was not tested on a physical Galaxy S25 and was not played through to the end.
integrationEdits: Only the crossover folder was copied.
The Lilita font file the prototype already used is copied beside it, and the stylesheet points at fonts/lilita.woff2 instead of the parent repo.
No service worker and no save keys in this build.
noindex, prototype label, and a back link to this shelf.
